display.purpose: Hero offers and large page headlines; high-contrast editorial emphasis.

headline.purpose: File, folder, and section headings that carry the narrative hierarchy.

title.purpose: Compact process and work titles that need a practical reading rhythm.

body.purpose: Readable explanatory copy, ledes, prose, metadata, and supporting detail.

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked filing labels, tabs, navigation, and footer metadata.

field.purpose: The smaller practical text size used by contact form labels and controls.

button.purpose: Compact action text with restrained tracking and inherited body leading.

shadows.name: file-overlap
shadows.purpose: Separates each rising file as it overlays the previous file.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Supports the desk/file reading path through the page.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Turns off smooth scrolling and sticky file behavior for motion-sensitive visitors.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Allows navigation to scroll horizontally and reduces small label sizes.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Enables two-column work/post rows and hides the compact header CTA below this width.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Enables the two-column page split used by contact and other interior layouts.

texture.name: paper-grain
texture.purpose: Repeating desk-blotter texture on the body; the CSS sets background-size to 1800px.

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--orchid); background: var(--orchid); color: var(--on-orchid); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.65; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--orchid-deep); border-color: var(--orchid-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orchid); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--orchid-deep); border-color: var(--orchid-deep); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A transparent ink button for a lower-emphasis path, with a quiet paper hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.65; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orchid); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--paper-2); }

components.name: Project Field

components.css: .ds-folder { background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); } .ds-folder-label { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; line-height: 1.65; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-folder h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.02; } .ds-folder-copy { margin: 1rem 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-ui); line-height: 1.65; max-width: 60ch; }

components.css: .ds-site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; min-height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 92%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-brand { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-site-header nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(0.85rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem); } .ds-site-header nav > a { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-site-header nav > a:hover, .ds-site-header nav > a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink); } .ds-site-header .ds-nav-cta { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; background: var(--orchid); border: 1px solid var(--orchid); color: var(--on-orchid); } .ds-site-header .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--orchid-deep); border-color: var(--orchid-deep); } .ds-site-header .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orchid); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-site-header .ds-nav-cta { display: none; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-site-header nav { gap: 0.75rem; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-site-header nav > a { font-size: 0.625rem; white-space: nowrap; } }

narrative.overview:
Expediente treats the site as a sheet of careful paperwork on a real desk: warm paper, warm-black ink, and a single uncommon purple that reads like a folder field. It is editorial without becoming precious—large type carries the offer, while labels, rules, and tabs make the work feel filed, inspectable, and ready to ship.

The world is intentionally not a dark name-role-cards portfolio. It leaves air in the first viewport, uses no gradients, and gets depth from paper texture, tonal surfaces, hairline borders, and the overlap of rising files. The home story moves from the offer to proof to a clear email action without adding decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-first surfaces with a repeated `paper.webp` desk texture.
Bodoni Moda for display and Archivo for body copy, labels, and controls.
Manganese purple as a rare folder field, action color, link color, and focus color.
Hairline ink rules, square folders, gently softened 2px controls, and die-cut tabs.
Sticky, rising files that make the work feel organized rather than card-grid generic.

rules.name: The Purple Folder Rule
rules.body: Purple should read as a tangible folder field or a deliberate action. Do not dilute its rarity with gradients, decoration, or an all-purple page.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: When a surface has no stronger semantic reason to change, it stays paper.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Bodoni carries display emphasis; Archivo carries every functional or explanatory voice. Do not introduce a third type family for UI decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat at rest. Use texture, tone, rules, and the file overlap shadow to make depth—not gradients, glass, or generic elevation presets.

rules.name: The Die-Cut Rule
rules.body: Use the clipped tab silhouette for filing cues; do not turn every control into a pill or rounded card.

dos: Do let `colors.paper` and the repeated paper texture be the default canvas.
Do use Bodoni Moda for the display/headline hierarchy and Archivo for body, labels, navigation, and controls.
Do reserve `colors.orchid` for folder fields, primary actions, links, selection, and focus; use `colors.orchid-deep` for their pressed/edge state.
Do keep structure visible with one-pixel ink rules and use the `2px` radius only where the CSS already does.
Do use the file/tab geometry and rising sticky overlap when a surface needs to feel like an Expediente, not a generic list of cards.
donts: Don't bring back a dark name-role-cards portfolio or replace the paper desk with a dark app-shell treatment.
Don't add gradients, glossy glass, or a new shadow vocabulary.
Don't turn the purple accent into a full-page wash, decorative pattern, or pill system.
Don't substitute rounded cards for the square folder/file silhouette or replace hairline rules with heavy separators.
Don't introduce another display or UI type family without changing the established two-font system deliberately.
